MATERIAL: brushed B4C porcelain ceramic on the ring surface. Subtle micro-grain visible. Shallow subsurface scattering on the porcelain. NOT vinyl. NOT glossy plastic. NOT chrome. NOT mirror reflection (no environment to reflect anyway). Industrial precision finish. Hyper-real material rendering.

PHASE 1 BASELINE — NO GOLDEN PATCH EVENT YET: the Enso ring is dormant / pre-intervention. No clean digital gold accent anywhere in the frame. The Golden Patch is a separate intervention motif rendered in future briefs only.

COLOR DISCIPLINE: porcelain white field + cold-cyan #00C8FF sync line only. No warm color anywhere in the frame. NO amber. NO orange. NO warm gold. NO hero gold. NO fantasy gold. NO crimson #E60000. NO electric violet. NO neon purple. NO any saturated color besides the cyan sync line.

MOOD: system at rest. Root infrastructure. Pre-intervention stillness. Absolute order. The image reads as 'the operating system seen from inside its own kernel' — not as a character, not as a place, but as the substrate that other characters and places execute on top of.
